biography.plain_text: Rovnag Ibrahim oglu Abdullayev is an Azerbaijani civil engineer and public official who led the state oil company SOCAR before becoming deputy economy minister. His career began in offshore construction and included running the Heydar Aliyev Baku Oil Refinery. He also served in parliament and headed Azerbaijan's national football association.

long_biography.plain_text:
Football administrator Rovnag Abdullayev treated the national team's development as a task that began with younger players. At the Azerbaijan federation, he prioritised grassroots participation, education and facilities. He sought technical and financial assistance from UEFA and argued that stronger local provision was necessary before expecting better international results.

The federation organised boys' leagues across six age groups and competitions for teenage girls. Infrastructure support also reached regional towns: UEFA funding helped renovate the technical centre in Tovuz and upgrade Shamakhi's stadium with a synthetic pitch and new player facilities. Abdullayev welcomed the Shamakhi project as a way to popularise football.
